findings.disposition: exempted: the envelope and the ceiling arrival are the reading the section uses, and the same window is quantified in the evidence record's table (hours at or above 80% and 90% of limit).
findings.summary: The grey baseline series oscillates so rapidly between about 70% and 100% over roughly 25-60 h that the individual excursions render as a dense picket of near-vertical strokes, reading as a solid hatched block. Its upper envelope and its arrival at the limit are clear, but the behaviour inside that stretch cannot be resolved by eye.

findings.disposition: exempted: the caption states both red markers are the two dated kill events, and the two markers read as one visual group under a single annotation.
findings.summary: Only the right-hand red marker carries the leader line to the 'OOM kills' annotation; the left marker near 35 h stands unlabelled, so a reader who does not read the caption cannot tell from the figure alone whether it marks the same kind of event.

findings.disposition: exempted: the caption states the baseline job's 64-hour lifetime, so the shorter span is stated where the reader meets the figure.
findings.summary: The grey series stops abruptly near 62 h while the x-axis runs on to about 130 h and the blue series ends near 118 h, leaving roughly 12 h of empty plot at the right. In-figure the grey termination is indistinguishable from missing data, and the empty tail spends width on no data.

rubric_items.contrast: Pass. All text is dark on white and reads cleanly; the grey threshold labels are mid-grey but legible at the rendered size, and the grey data stroke is a deliberate neutral, distinguishable from the blue subject series.
rubric_items.data_ink: Pass. The ink is the two series, two machine-readable thresholds (80% and 90% of limit, dotted grey) and the kill markers with one annotation. No fill, no gradient, white ground; nothing decorative competes with the traces.
rubric_items.decoration: Pass. No gridlines, no shading, no background fill, no in-figure title or suptitle. Only the left and bottom spines carry a scale; the threshold rules are dashed grey, not shaded bands.
rubric_items.label_collision: Pass. No label is clipped by the canvas edge; the tick labels, axis labels, legend entries, the two threshold annotations and the 'OOM kills' annotation do not overlap one another. The 'OOM kills' text sits in clear space above both traces, the threshold labels sit in the empty right margin beyond the data, and the kill markers sit on the series by design rather than over a label.
rubric_items.legibility: Pass. Both axes name their quantity and unit ('job memory [% of limit]', 'hours since job start'); a frameless two-entry legend above the plot names each job with its limit; the grey baseline's ceiling-bound excursion and the blue job's mid-limit trace are distinguishable at a glance, and the two red kill markers are visible without hunting.
rubric_items.table_form: Pass. This is a continuous time series over roughly 0-118 h, not information whose natural form is a table; the tabulated readings the section asks for live in the evidence record's table, not in the figure.
